theme.en: AI Demand Rewires the Silicon Stack

dek.en: Cloud operators are widening their accelerator bets while memory, packaging and wafer tools absorb capacity pressure. Public funding is moving toward photonics and specialized compute as supply-chain resilience becomes a design constraint.
dek.zh: 云服务商正扩大加速器押注，存储、先进封装与晶圆设备承接产能压力。随着供应链韧性成为设计约束，公共资金也流向硅光子和专用计算。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Microsoft plans AMD Helios and Nvidia Vera Rubin rack-scale deployments
title.zh: 微软计划部署AMD Helios与NVIDIA Vera Rubin机架级系统

summary.en: Microsoft says Azure will be among the first cloud platforms to deploy rack-scale AI infrastructure based on AMD Helios and Nvidia Vera Rubin. The report says Helios may cost roughly 40% more than Vera Rubin, showing that Microsoft is preserving supplier optionality even as system costs rise. The competition is moving from individual GPUs to integrated racks, networking and power delivery.
summary.zh: 微软表示，Azure将成为最早部署基于AMD Helios和NVIDIA Vera Rubin的机架级AI基础设施的云平台之一。报道称，Helios成本可能比Vera Rubin高约40%，显示微软即使面对系统成本上升仍保留多供应商选择。竞争正从单颗GPU转向集成机架、网络与供电系统。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Intel targets advanced packages beyond 24× reticle size
title.zh: Intel瞄准超过24倍光罩尺寸的先进封装

summary.en: Intel says advances in New Mexico remove an encapsulation constraint that had limited very large multi-die systems, with the report pointing to packages beyond 24 times reticle size. Such scaling is central to assembling AI systems from chiplets when a monolithic die is no longer economical or manufacturable. Yield, substrate availability and thermal design remain the practical tests at these dimensions.
summary.zh: Intel称其在新墨西哥州的技术进展消除了限制超大型多芯粒系统的一项封装约束，报道指向超过24倍光罩尺寸的封装。当天然单片大芯片不再具备经济性或可制造性时，这种扩展能力是以chiplet构建AI系统的关键。良率、封装基板供给和散热设计仍是这一尺寸下的实际考验。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Samsung posts record profit on device and memory sales
title.zh: 三星凭借器件与存储销售实现创纪录利润

summary.en: Samsung Electronics reported an all-time-high profit, with device and memory sales driving the result. It adds evidence that AI infrastructure demand is feeding through to memory suppliers as well as accelerator vendors. Strong earnings give Samsung more room to fund HBM capacity, though execution against established suppliers remains a separate question.
summary.zh: 三星电子公布创纪录利润，器件和存储销售是主要驱动力。这进一步表明，AI基础设施需求不仅利好加速器厂商，也正在传导至存储供应商。强劲盈利让三星有更多空间投入HBM产能，但能否赶上既有供应商仍是另一项考验。

title.en: Apacer chief warns commodity DRAM supply could fall 70% in 2027
title.zh: Apacer负责人警告2027年通用DRAM供给或下降70%

summary.en: Apacer CEO C.K. Chang said commodity DRAM supply could fall by as much as 70% in 2027 as HBM consumes more wafer capacity, echoing concerns from SK hynix. The claim is a forecast, not an industry plan, but it captures the allocation tension between AI-focused HBM and mainstream DRAM. If sustained, that trade-off would widen price and availability differences across memory segments.
summary.zh: Apacer首席执行官张国森表示，随着HBM占用更多晶圆产能，2027年通用DRAM供给可能最多下降70%，呼应了SK hynix的供给担忧。该说法是预测而非行业量产计划，但它揭示了AI用HBM与主流DRAM之间的产能分配矛盾。若趋势持续，不同存储细分市场的价格和可得性差异将扩大。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Lam Research guidance exceeds analyst expectations by $1 billion
title.zh: Lam Research业绩指引较分析师预期高出10亿美元

summary.en: Lam Research issued guidance reported to be $1 billion above analysts' expectations as AI-related chip capacity demand remains strong. For wafer-fab equipment suppliers, guidance is an early signal that customers are converting AI demand into process-tool orders. It must still be read alongside customer capital-spending plans because memory and logic cycles can diverge sharply.
summary.zh: 据报道，Lam Research给出的业绩指引比分析师预期高出10亿美元，反映AI相关芯片产能需求依然强劲。对晶圆制造设备供应商而言，指引是客户将AI需求转化为工艺设备订单的早期信号。仍需结合客户资本开支计划解读，因为存储和逻辑的投资周期可能明显分化。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: US awards GlobalFoundries $300 million for silicon photonics and takes 1% stake
title.zh: 美国向GlobalFoundries提供3亿美元硅光子资金并持有1%股份

summary.en: The US government will provide GlobalFoundries $300 million to pursue silicon photonics and take a 1% equity stake, according to the report. Combining grant funding and ownership aligns public support with optical interconnect technology used to move data among AI systems. It extends industrial policy beyond leading-edge logic into links that increasingly constrain large clusters.
summary.zh: 据报道，美国政府将向GlobalFoundries提供3亿美元用于推进硅光子技术，并取得其1%的股权。将拨款与持股结合，是把公共支持与AI系统数据互连技术直接绑定的少见做法。此举将产业政策从先进逻辑扩展到日益限制大型集群扩展的光互连。

title.en: Aeluma set to receive $30 million in CHIPS funding
title.zh: Aeluma将获得3000万美元CHIPS资金

summary.en: Aeluma is set to receive $30 million in CHIPS funding, according to the report. The award points to continued use of US incentives for compound-semiconductor capability rather than only high-volume digital logic. Smaller allocations can be material for specialized suppliers because pilot lines, packaging and qualification costs are large relative to revenue.
summary.zh: 据报道，Aeluma将获得3000万美元CHIPS资金。该奖励表明，美国激励措施仍在支持化合物半导体能力，而不仅仅是大规模数字逻辑制造。对专业供应商而言，较小的资金规模也可能意义重大，因为试产线、封装和认证成本相对于收入很高。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 新兴挑战者

title.en: Disaggregated inference pairs AMD Helios with Cerebras
title.zh: 解耦推理将AMD Helios与Cerebras组合

summary.en: A disaggregated-inference design pairs AMD's Helios platform with Cerebras hardware, assigning different parts of the serving stack to different compute systems. It seeks to balance throughput and latency rather than asking one accelerator architecture to optimize every stage. The approach shows how alternative AI-chip suppliers can enter deployments through composable systems instead of wholesale platform replacement.
summary.zh: 一种解耦推理设计将AMD的Helios平台与Cerebras硬件结合，把服务栈的不同部分分配给不同计算系统。它试图平衡吞吐量和延迟，而不是要求一种加速器架构优化所有环节。该方法表明，替代型AI芯片供应商可通过可组合系统进入部署，而无需整体替换平台。

theme.en: Efficiency Moves Across Devices and Models
theme.zh: 效率优化贯穿器件与模型

dek.en: This week's papers connect device-level models and circuits with techniques for more efficient AI inference. The common thread is reducing costly computation or calibration without giving up measured reliability.
dek.zh: 本周论文把器件级建模与电路研究，同提升AI推理效率的技术联系起来。共同主线是在不牺牲可验证可靠性的前提下，减少昂贵的计算或校准。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: TiO2 Memristor Model for Neuromorphic Circuit Simulation
title.zh: 用于神经形态电路仿真的TiO2忆阻器模型

papers.authors: Lukas Endres, Hannes Töpfer, Michaela Blum, et al.

summary.en: This work derives and validates a SPICE-ready model for a volatile TiO2 memristor using experimental electrical measurements. The model reproduces continuous and pulsed behavior and is demonstrated in a leaky integrate-and-fire neuron simulation. It gives circuit designers a calibrated model for exploring neuromorphic behavior, though other TiO2 stacks need separate validation.
summary.zh: 该研究基于实验电学测量，建立并验证了可用于SPICE的易失性TiO2忆阻器模型。模型能再现连续和脉冲激励下的行为，并在漏积分发放神经元仿真中展示。它让电路设计人员可使用经校准的模型探索神经形态行为，但其他TiO2器件堆叠仍需单独验证。

title.en: Circuits & Systems
title.zh: 电路与系统

title.en: Dual-Mode FM/AM Modulator Using a Time-Varying Inverting Integrator
title.zh: 基于时变反相积分器的双模FM/AM调制器

papers.authors: Azalía G. Gil, Alfonso T. Muriel-Barrado, Mario Pérez-Escribano, et al.

summary.en: The paper presents a dual-mode frequency/amplitude modulator using a time-modulated varactor, an inverting integrator and a passband filter. The team fabricated a microstrip PCB prototype and reports measured results that agree with theory and ADS simulations. The experimental grounding is useful, although integration into a semiconductor RF process is not addressed.
summary.zh: 论文提出一种双模调频/调幅调制器，采用时变变容二极管、反相积分器和带通滤波器。团队制备了微带PCB原型，测量结果与理论及ADS仿真一致。这一实验验证很有价值，但尚未涉及如何集成到半导体射频工艺。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: AgenticCANN: Automated Ascend C Operator Generation
title.zh: AgenticCANN：自动生成Ascend C算子

papers.authors: Junhao Qiu, Zidong Wang, Yansong Sun, et al.

summary.en: AgenticCANN uses a knowledge-augmented agentic-evolution workflow to generate and tune Ascend C operators for Huawei NPUs. On an Ascend 910B, the authors evaluate six operators across five pattern categories and report gains over their baselines. Operator tuning is often the step that turns theoretical accelerator capability into inference throughput, but the reported gains depend on the kernels and setup tested.
summary.zh: AgenticCANN采用知识增强的智能体演化流程，为Huawei NPU生成并调优Ascend C算子。作者在Ascend 910B上评估了涵盖五类模式的六个算子，并报告了优于基线的结果。算子调优常是把理论加速器能力转化为推理吞吐的关键步骤，但所报告的提升仍依赖于测试内核和评测设置。

title.en: AI Systems & Research
title.zh: AI系统与研究

title.en: Calibrated Reasoning and Cloud Deferral for Edge LLM Agents
title.zh: 面向边缘LLM智能体的校准推理与云端延后决策

summary.en: Think Short, Defer Smart combines a probe that stops on-device reasoning when actions stabilize with a perplexity rule for escalating uncertain actions to the cloud. The method is calibrated on full trajectories and evaluated across four ReAct-style benchmarks. It targets the edge-inference trade-off of saving local compute and cloud calls without assuming short reasoning is reliable.
summary.zh: Think Short, Defer Smart把动作稳定后停止端侧推理的探针，与基于困惑度的规则结合，在动作不确定时升级到云端模型。该方法在完整轨迹上校准，并在四个ReAct式基准上评估。它针对边缘推理中节省本地计算和云端调用的权衡，同时不假设短推理必然可靠。

title.en: ReCo: Reweighting GRPO to Preserve Diverse Reasoning Paths
title.zh: ReCo：通过重加权GRPO保留多样化推理路径

papers.authors: Junoh Park, Junseo Hwang, Wonguk Cho, Taesup Kim

summary.en: ReCo modifies GRPO so common high-probability responses do not dominate the gradient and alternative token choices retain learning signal. The authors attribute concentration to repeated responses within a rollout group and to the token-level importance ratio. If it generalizes beyond the tested math benchmarks and model sizes, it could preserve broader reasoning coverage during post-training.
summary.zh: ReCo修改GRPO，使常见的高概率回答不会主导梯度，并让替代token选择保留学习信号。作者将集中化归因于rollout组中的重复回答以及token级重要性比率。若能推广到已测试数学基准和模型规模之外，它可能在后训练中保留更广的推理覆盖。

title.en: WhisperRec: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Recommendation Models
title.zh: WhisperRec：面向高效推荐模型的潜在推理

papers.authors: Hao Jiang, Peiru Du, Pengfei Yao, et al.

summary.en: WhisperRec compresses teacher-generated chain-of-thought into learnable latent reasoning tokens for foundation recommendation models. Reasoning in latent space rather than emitting rationales aims to retain decision-relevant information while lowering inference overhead. The approach suits latency-sensitive serving, although latent reasoning is harder to inspect and needs careful robustness evaluation.
summary.zh: WhisperRec把教师模型生成的思维链压缩为可学习的潜在推理token，用于基础推荐模型。在潜在空间推理而非产生推理文本，目标是在保留决策相关信息的同时降低推理开销。该方法适合对延迟敏感的服务，但潜在推理更难检查，仍需审慎评估鲁棒性。
